items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Dizzy agreed to go up and play it with us. And Dizzy made the four weeks with us.

ctx.x: And that would give you an idea what you'll be up against, you know. You get an -- hear something.

I look at all the music today that's (inaudible). You know, they go to school. But if they could just get an idea -- go out in a club where maybe ten or fifteen musicians, this guy will show up. Dexter Gordon will show up, you know. Dizzy would come in, you know.
Got to be behind these guys to hear them play.
